rules.in_bin: body center: abs(local_x)<=0.243, abs(local_y)<=0.143, -0.01<=local_z<=0.24; same for examples
rules.ready: same basket as preceding sample AND inside AND no robot contact AND linear speed<0.04 m/s AND angular speed<0.3 rad/s; increment stable ticks, else zero; ready at ceil(0.5*Hz)=10 ticks (first in-bin detection is tick zero)
rules.ownership: fixed example categories persist; nonfixed basket clears ownership only when no targets or examples inside; ready targets claim unassigned category in ascending target ID order
rules.mixed: more than one category among all present targets, examples and fixed category; readiness not required
rules.counted: (ready OR previously_counted) AND inside basket AND basket pure AND assigned category matches; leaving, mixing or mismatch removes points
rules.score: 100*counted_targets/N, recomputed each control tick; examples excluded; use final total_score at timeout, not peak or accumulated reward
rules.success: all targets counted AND all currently ready AND every example in original basket AND no mixed basket; hold ceil(Hz)=20 consecutive qualifying ticks
rules.completion: all_objects_sorted is terminal success; intermediate recycling/placement/removal events do not alone imply success
rules.horizon: 6000 control steps=300 simulated seconds; keep partial score at timeout
rules.transport: only untouched belt objects recycle; preserve pose and velocity except X translation -4 m; hidden dynamics frozen; interacted/dropped targets not auto-returned
rules.nonfinite: unified replay marks group invalid, not ordinary zero-score failure
rules.certification: Every saved Episode must replay exactly; all three saved Scenarios must reset without robot penetration; public bounded actions must reach both conveyor pickup regions and every basket opening within 0.04 m. This is a geometric reachability certificate, not a policy success-rate claim.

episode_randomization.storage: Episode variation + runtime + initial_state; Task scenario is the baseline
episode_randomization.schedule: independently shuffled five-stratum batches; two practice batches and one exam batch use the same domain; phone small count alternates 2/3
episode_randomization.replay: rebuild resolved Episode model; verify full runtime identity; restore exact initial state; no resampling during reset/step
episode_randomization.policy_visibility: qualitative runtime English instructions only; sampled values, solution axes, small-support names and files remain private
